title: Understanding the Forces
text: To find the angle, consider the forces acting on the passenger. The vertical force is due to gravity, and the horizontal force is due to the acceleration of the sled.

title: Calculate the Vertical Force
text: The vertical force is the gravitational force acting on the passenger. Use the formula: $$F_{\text{gravity}}$$=m*g, $$where$$ $$\, \text{m$$} $$is$$ $$the$$ $$mass$$ $$and$$ $$g$$ is the acceleration due to gravity ($$9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$).

title: Calculate the Horizontal Force
text: The horizontal force is due to the acceleration of the sled. Use the formula: $$F_{\text{horizontal}}$$=m*a, $$where$$ $$\, \text{m$$} $$is$$ $$the$$ $$mass$$ $$and$$ $$a$$ is the acceleration of the sled ($$49.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$).

title: Find the Angle
text: The angle above the horizontal can be found using the tangent function: tan($$\theta$$)=$$F_{\text{vertical}}$$/$$F_{\text{horizontal}}$$. Solve for $$\theta$$.

title: Calculate the Angle
text: Use the tangent function to find the angle: $$\tan(\theta)=735.0/3675.0$$. $$Solve$$ $$for$$ $$\theta$$.
